name: noisy_touchdown_release
hypothesis: White force noise differs from the tolerated sustained drift. During the many samples of insertion, a surviving filtered excursion can cross the low 0.5 N touchdown threshold before physical support, causing premature release.
expected_failure: Step 6 reports touchdown before seating, releases the plate above its supports, and fails the seating check after an uncontrolled drop.
real_world_story: An aging wrist sensor develops intermittent electrical noise from a damaged cable shield.
